name: Park Jae-Hyun
bio:
Park Jae-Hyun's journey into motorsport began with a fascination for aerodynamics during his mechanical engineering studies. He was captivated by the blend of art and science required to optimize a racing car's performance. After graduating from KAIST, he landed a position at a local engineering firm, quickly proving his worth through innovative solutions to complex problems. His passion for racing eventually led him to Europe, where he honed his skills working with several junior formula teams before joining Racing Bulls.

Jae-Hyun's approach to performance engineering is characterized by meticulous data analysis and a keen eye for detail. He's known for his ability to identify subtle areas for improvement, translating complex data into actionable strategies for the drivers and mechanics. A firm believer in continuous improvement, Jae-Hyun is always seeking out new technologies and methodologies to gain a competitive edge. His visionary perspective often challenges conventional wisdom, pushing the team to explore unconventional solutions that yield significant performance gains.

His perfectionist tendencies, coupled with his deep understanding of vehicle dynamics, make him a valuable asset to the team. He is committed to pushing the boundaries of what's possible in motorsport, ensuring that Racing Bulls remains at the forefront of innovation.
